title: WEN 10236F2 Quick-Adjust 36-Inch Steel Bar Clamps with 2.5-Inch Throat and Micro-Adjustment Handle, Two Pack , Multicolor

reviews.title: Good quality bar clamps
reviews.body: New experience for me using bar clamps.  I did get 3 different sizes and 4 of each because I thought this would cover the different projects to do.  They are good and sturdy and easy to use.  They were not to heavy for me to manage but are real strong bars.  It was easy to adjust the clamps and tighten them.  They did not budge.  So I thought I got a good buy for the quality of the bars.

reviews.title: Great value for long and effective clamps
reviews.body: Great value if all you need are some long inexpensive clamps. They aren't the most convenient, but they are very effective and straight forward. Use the money you save for the corner clamps if you are assembling cabinets.

reviews.title: A good set of clamps for a small working wood shop
reviews.body: These are decent clamps but the bars did bow a little during the first glue up I used them on. Nonetheless, they’re pretty strong, have a decent grip, and are the right size for my needs. I like how adjustable they are and like I said, they apply enough pressure for the glue ups I’m doing.Let’s face it. A large part of woodworking is problem solving and making due with what you have and you can afford.For now, these clamps are getting boards glued up and helping me make product so that I can eventually upgrade to parallel clamps. Are they ideal? Not really, but another part of woodworking is always needing/wanting to buy a better tool. Even when I do upgrade my clamps, I’ll keep using these.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on March 15, 2025

reviews.title: Awesome purchase
reviews.body: Awesome, heavy duty, great quality. Would buy again. Good weight, grips are rubberish plastic, size is optimal, great utility for larger projects, tabs to removal are easy to manipulate and adjust.

reviews.author: alex dixon

reviews.title: Good clamps, feel like they'll hold up well
reviews.body: I'm not a pro, but these feel like very solid clamps. The steel is thick and heavy, the handles feel good, the threading is tight, and the release feels solid. I haven't had any issues with the rubber coming off of the ends, and I've clamped these down VERY hard on some steel bases to get things into place, and they've held up great. They've never come unclamped and the ratcheting mechanism has never broke free on its own. I don't expect to have to replace these for a very long time.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 21, 2023

reviews.title: Affordable clamps
reviews.body: These have came in handy in more ways than I got them for.  I got them for clamping wood projects together but have used them for endless things from working on the house to working on the mower.  The clamp design makes them easy to use.  The twist handles are like a plastic with rubber grip which is nice when tightening them down.  I need more but keep forgetting to get them when I have money.
